_comment_pillars: Formula v10 indicator set (SPEC §2): pillar weights unchanged from v9.1; removed gpi_overall, gpi_militarisation, wb_child_mortality, wb_air_pollution, inform_health (= INFORM Human) and inform_climate (= River Flood). The 'environment' key is kept to limit blast radius; its visible label is 'Natural hazards'. Its sub-weights are relative (0.25/0.10/0.10, sum 0.45): the engine renormalises sub-weights over the indicators present, as the v10 prototype did.

formulaV9._comment: Formula v9.1 (Bayesian synthesis + D1 homicide/D2 UCDP/D3 GPI-2026/D4 advisory ramp) frozen constants, ported verbatim from prototype-scorer-v91.mjs DEFAULT_CONST + ADVISORY_TIER + FROZEN_EXCLUDED_SOURCES + ADVISORY_REBASE + REGION_OFFSET (final-constants-v91.json round-2 section: P_HALF=200000). KEY NAME stays 'formulaV9' — engine.ts reads this key regardless of the formula's own version number. Do not re-tune. Formula v10 (SPEC 2026-10-14, .planning/quick/261014-formula-v10/SPEC.md) leaves every v9.1 constant here unchanged and adds maxAgeYears, minSources, calibration and community below.
formulaV9._comment_maxAgeYears: v10 SPEC §1.2: a non-advisory indicator whose data year < (run year - maxAgeYears) is missing, before pillars and before source counting (src/pipeline/scoring/max-age.ts). wb_population (homicide precision input, never scored) is exempt.
formulaV9._comment_minSources: v10 SPEC §4: fewer distinct sources than this after the max-age filter => scoreStatus insufficient_data (score null), unless the danger guard holds (src/pipeline/scoring/status.ts). Same floor as MIN_RANKING_SOURCES in src/lib/hub-data.ts, scripts/generate-llms-full.ts and src/pipeline/news/engine.ts.
formulaV9._comment_community: v10 SPEC §5: adjustment = clamp(Z * (P - S_data), -cap, +cap), Z = nEff / (nEff + k), applied only to officially scored countries whose entry in data/sentiment/latest.json is active AND meets minVotes/minOrigins/originCap (re-checked by the engine). Same values as src/pipeline/sentiment/constants.ts on the community branch.
